# Study Hub

> Study Hub is a study-management web application for organizing subjects, lectures, exams, schedules, flashcards, attachments, checklists, and academic progress.

## Main pages

- [Dashboard](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/): Overview, study streak, upcoming exams, calendar, and progress
- [Subjects](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/subjects): Subjects, lectures, attachments, exams, and study materials
- [Schedule](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/schedule): Exam dates, study schedules, calendar, and planned work
- [Checklist](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/checklist): Study tasks and task lists
- [Progress](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/progress): Lecture completion and exam-performance summaries

## Documentation

- [Site overview](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/index.md): Text description of Study Hub and its major features
- [Glossary](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/glossary.md): Definitions of key Study Hub terms
- [Sitemap](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/sitemap.md): Human- and agent-readable page directory
- [Agent guide](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/AGENTS.md): Usage, privacy, and configuration notes for automated agents
- [Full agent context](https://study-hub-97u.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Expanded product and navigation context

## Important notes

- Study Hub is an interactive client-side application and requires JavaScript for its full interface.
- User-created study data and attachments may be private. Automated agents must not expose, redistribute, or infer private academic information.
- The application does not advertise a public third-party API. Unknown API or protocol discovery paths should be treated as unavailable.
